Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.en: I noticed on the back of the box it says [i]'Series 2 Coming Soon.'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.pl: Zauważyłam, że z tyłu pudełka jest napisane [i]'Seria 2 już wkrótce'.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.en: Kinda [i]presumptious,[/i] isn't it? Considering you haven't even written the book yet.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.pl: Trochę [i]zarozumiałe,[/i] nie sądzisz? Zważywszy, że nawet jeszcze nie napisałeś książki.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.en: I raised a fuss about it at the time - my objections fell on deaf ears, as usual.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.pl: Zrobiłem wtedy z tego aferę - moje sprzeciwy trafiły w próżnię, jak zwykle.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.en: Why are they so keen to make a second movie, anyway?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.pl: Czemu w ogóle tak im zależy na drugim filmie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.en: [i]'Look out for Hex of the Helmsman 2, Only in Theatres.'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ActionFigure/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.en: [i]'Chart the unchartable, plot the unplottable, and measure the unmeasurable.'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.pl: [i]'Zmapuj niemapowalne, wykreśl niewykreślalne, i zmierz niemierzalne'.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.en: I... think it's a little much - for a shop that sells [i]compasses?[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.pl: Ja... myślę, że to trochę przesada - jak na sklep, który sprzedaje [i]kompasy?[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.en: ...it - it's not about the compasses. The thing he's really selling is [h]wanderlust.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.pl: ...to - to nie chodzi o kompasy. To, co on naprawdę sprzedaje, to [h]żądza podróży.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.en: The desire to explore the world and experience the unknown.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.pl: Pragnienie eksplorowania świata i doświadczania nieznanego.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BalloonBasket/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.en: Oh, a locked box, what is inside? [i]Ohhh, I must find out at once-[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.pl: Och, zamknięte pudełko, co w środku? [i]Ochh, muszę się dowiedzieć natychmiast-[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.en: Half the time, with things like this, the writer hasn't even worked out what's inside-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.pl: W połowie przypadków, przy takich rzeczach, autor nawet nie wymyślił, co jest w środku-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.en: -they just want the reader to speculate - keeps 'em invested.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.pl: -chcą po prostu, żeby czytelnik spekulował - to utrzymuje jego zaangażowanie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.en: Okay, but this is real. It's not somebody's fiction.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.pl: Okej, ale to jest prawdziwe. To nie czyjaś fikcja.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.en: I bet there's [i]nothing[/i] inside! Look, I'll shake it -
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.pl: Założę się, że w środku [i]nic[/i] nie ma! Patrzcie, potrząsnę tym -
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.en: Maybe someone planted the box to distract you, knowing you'd get all curious?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.pl: Może ktoś podrzucił to pudełko, żeby was rozproszyć, wiedząc, że zrobicie się ciekawscy?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlackBox/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sec.en: A [i]photo.[/i] Of a mermaid floating in a crystalline orb? Hm? Held aloft by a muscular demon werewolf?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sec.pl: [i]Zdjęcie.[/i] Syreny unoszącej się w kryształowej kuli? Hm? Trzymanej w górze przez umięśnionego demonicznego wilkołaka?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.en: Uh - cogs falling out... too many needles, all pointing in different directions-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.pl: Yy - wypadające zębatki... za dużo igieł, wszystkie wskazujące różne kierunki-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.en: Well, maybe you're just part-way through being fixed.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.pl: Cóż, może jesteś po prostu w trakcie naprawy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.en: Sometimes you gotta make a mess in order to tidy up, you know?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.pl: Czasem trzeba narobić bałaganu, żeby móc posprzątać, wiesz?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.en: You know what, that's rather [i]eloquent.[/i] Bravo.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.pl: Wiesz co, to było całkiem [i]elokwentne.[/i] Brawo.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.en: Grimoire, did you hear? I said something [i]eloquent.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE BrokenCompass/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.en: But, nope. He never wore it. Never even looked at it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.pl: Ale, nie. Nigdy jej nie nosił. Nawet na nią nie spojrzał.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.en: It's gaudy, sure, but when I first saw it I thought;
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.pl: Jest krzykliwa, jasne, ale kiedy zobaczyłem ją po raz pierwszy, pomyślałem;
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.en: [i]'Ah - good! Mortuga will be a man of Melodrama and Romance! Just what I'm looking for.'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.pl: [i]'Ach - dobrze! Mortuga będzie człowiekiem Melodramatu i Romansu! Właśnie tego szukałem'.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsJacket/.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.en: I'm sure Sinthia's intending to fix it, although she might-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.pl: Jestem pewien, że Sinthia zamierza to naprawić, chociaż może-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.en: The machine that spits these out must be broken...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.pl: Maszyna, która to wypluwa, musi być zepsuta...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.en: On the latest card - the readings towards the end are all messed up.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.pl: Na najnowszej karcie - odczyty pod koniec są całkowicie pomieszane.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.en: Looks like a misaligned printer head - bane of my [i]existence[/i], those things.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.pl: Wygląda na przesuniętą głowicę drukującą - te rzeczy to zmora mojego [i]życia.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaptainsLog/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.en: Do you recognise any of the objects?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.en: Yeah, the golden hand. I've seen it - and so have you.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.pl: Tak, złotą dłoń. Widziałem ją - i ty też.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.en: It's attached to Dr Zephyr's left wrist.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.pl: Jest przyczepiona do lewego nadgarstka Dra Zephyra.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.en: Not quite. Says here it's made of 'an unknown material [i]90% similar[/i] to Gold.'
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.pl: Niezupełnie. Tu jest napisane, że jest zrobiona z 'nieznanego materiału [i]w 90% podobnego[/i] do złota'.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.en: Now, it also says it's able to [i]'touch ghosts'[/i] - so best take it with a grain of salt.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.pl: Poza tym jest też napisane, że jest w stanie [i]'dotykać duchów'[/i] - więc najlepiej podejść do tego z przymrużeniem oka.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaretakersJourn.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaseFile/Sectio.en: [i]Murder victim, locked himself in the room, body discovered, no weapon found, cauldron opened for the first time...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaseFile/Sectio.pl: [i]Ofiara morderstwa, zamknął się w pomieszczeniu, znaleziono ciało, nie znaleziono broni, kocioł otwarty po raz pierwszy...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaseFile/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaseFile/Sectio.en: Yeah. Nice. Just enough information to hook you, without giving too much away.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaseFile/Sectio.pl: Tak. Ładnie. Dokładnie tyle informacji, żeby zaciekawić, bez zdradzania zbyt wiele.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CaseFile/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.en: Ugh, I can't [i]stand[/i] these things. A procrastinator's worst nightmare.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.pl: Ugh, nie [i]znoszę[/i] tych rzeczy. Najgorszy koszmar prokrastynatora.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.en: It's why I use the old typewriter - no distractions.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.pl: Dlatego używam starej maszyny do pisania - żadnych rozpraszaczy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.en: Does Dirk spend a lot of time on his cell phone?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.pl: Czy Dirk spędza dużo czasu na telefonie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.en: Not in here - he goes up on deck to do it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.pl: Nie tutaj - wychodzi na pokład, żeby to robić.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.en: Eh, who knows? It's not my business.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.pl: Eh, kto wie? To nie mój interes.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CellPhone/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.en: Yeah, he clearly used my typewriter to make it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.pl: Tak, wyraźnie użył mojej maszyny do pisania, żeby to zrobić.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.en: So, I noticed Mortuga's contract has been - [i]typed.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.pl: Więc, zauważyłem, że kontrakt Mortugi został - [i]napisany na maszynie.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.en: So how did he know how to use it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.pl: Więc skąd wiedział, jak jej użyć?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.en: Mortuga might've been... you know, [i]outdoorsy[/i], but he wasn't an idiot.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.pl: Mortuga może i był... no wiesz, [i]typem na świeżym powietrzu,[/i] ale nie był idiotą.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CommandContract.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.en: It's a [h]strong[/h] image - the ancient cauldron, opened for the very first time...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.pl: To [h]mocny[/h] obraz - starożytny kocioł, otwarty po raz pierwszy w historii...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.en: It can't be the [h]very[/h] first time - someone must've opened it before.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.pl: Nie może to być [h]dosłownie[/h] pierwszy raz - ktoś musiał go otworzyć wcześniej.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.en: Soo what d'you think was inside?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.pl: Więęc co myślisz, co było w środku?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.en: I'm - pretty sure it [i]does.[/i] It might explain how or why Mortuga died.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.pl: Jestem - dość pewien, że [i]tak.[/i] Może to wyjaśnić, jak lub czemu Mortuga zginął.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.en: True. The, uh - murder weapon, maybe?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.pl: Prawda. To, yy - narzędzie zbrodni, może?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.en: Sure, why not. It would explain the scratches on the inside, after all.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.pl: Jasne, czemu nie. W końcu wyjaśniałoby to zadrapania w środku.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE CurseCauldron/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DivingLicense/S.en: And yet I feel like I recognise the handwriting...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DivingLicense/S.pl: A jednak mam wrażenie, że rozpoznaję to pismo...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DivingLicense/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DreamHelmet/Sec.en: Hmm, Dr Zephyr's got quite the imagination, doesn't he?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DreamHelmet/Sec.pl: Hmm, Dr Zephyr ma niezłą wyobraźnię, prawda?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DreamHelmet/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.en: Ahh, yes, Godrik's little mascot... sidekick... thing.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.pl: Achh, tak, mała maskotka Godrika... towarzysz... coś tam.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.en: To him , it may be a wooden stick of [h]great thunderous importance.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.pl: Dla niego, może to być drewniany kij o [h]wielkiej, gromowładnej wadze.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.en: You never found yourself attached to an inaminate object? Something that gained special meaning?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.pl: Nigdy nie przywiązaliście się do jakiegoś nieożywionego przedmiotu? Czegoś, co nabrało specjalnego znaczenia?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.en: Well, I did use to have this hat...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.en: There we go. We're all guilty of it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.pl: No właśnie. Wszyscy jesteśmy temu winni.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE DriftwoodCane/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.en: That man, on the right - that's Don Drummond, the shipyard mechanic.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.pl: Ten mężczyzna, po prawej - to Don Drummond, mechanik stoczni.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.en: I interviewed him once, working on a piece for the newspaper...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.pl: Przeprowadziłem z nim wywiad, kiedyś, pracując nad artykułem do gazety...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.en: Or - I tried to. He was a tough nut to crack.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.pl: Albo - próbowałem. Był twardym orzechem do zgryzienia.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.en: Well, he [h]was[/h] a lighthouse keeper. Comes with the territory, I guess.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.pl: Cóż, [h]był[/h] latarnikiem. To chyba wchodzi w zakres obowiązków.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.en: I couldn't believe it when I saw this in Mortuga's cabin...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.pl: Nie mogłem uwierzyć, kiedy zobaczyłem to w kajucie Mortugi...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.en: Yeah. This painting used to be in my house.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.pl: Tak. Ten obraz kiedyś wisiał w moim domu.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.en: In my father's study. It hung there for at least a year.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.pl: W gabinecie mojego ojca. Wisiał tam przez co najmniej rok.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.en: I believe he bought it from the town's Governor - a man named Fellow.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.pl: Wierzę, że kupił to od Gubernatora miasteczka - mężczyzny nazwiskiem Fellow.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.en: So how'd [h]Mortuga[/h] end up with it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FeliciaPainting.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.en: The crime scene. In a cabinet, hidden off to the side.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.pl: Miejsce zbrodni. W szafce, ukryte z boku.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.en: Oh, of [i]course[/i] there's a hidden cabinet! Oh it's just too good.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.pl: Och, [i]oczywiście,[/i] że jest ukryta szafka! Och, to jest po prostu za dobre.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.en: I don't know if it has anything to do with the murder, though...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.pl: Chociaż nie wiem, czy to ma cokolwiek wspólnego z morderstwem...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FilmProjector/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.pl: Co to za tandetny drobiazg z bazaru?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.en: It was in Zephyr's lab - it could be a [i]priceless curiosity.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.pl: Było to w laboratorium Zephyra - to może być [i]bezcenna osobliwość.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.en: Oh yeah? A priceless curiosity - that takes [i]Double A batteries?[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.pl: O tak? Bezcenna osobliwość - która działa na [i]baterie AA?[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE FogBall/Section.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.en: What's this? World's smallest piggy bank?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.pl: Co to jest? Najmniejsza skarbonka świata?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.en: What? It's not a [i]piggy bank[/i] - is it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.en: Well, it's got a slot, and there's something in there.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.pl: Cóż, ma szczelinę, i coś w środku.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.en: I thought maybe it was a penny.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GlassEyeball/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE GoldenLocket/Se.en: A mystical heirloom from her [i]tragically departed mother[/i], no doubt.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GoldenLocket/Se.pl: Mistyczna pamiątka rodzinna po jej [i]tragicznie zmarłej matce,[/i] bez wątpienia.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GoldenLocket/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE GoldenLocket/Se.en: Oh no - complete guess. But that's just how these things go, isn't it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GoldenLocket/Se.pl: Och nie - czysta zgadywanka. Ale tak to zwykle bywa, prawda?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE GoldenLocket/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandheldRadio/S.en: Or - possessed by an evil spirit. One of the two.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandheldRadio/S.pl: Albo - opętane przez złego ducha. Jedno z dwojga.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandheldRadio/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: It's mine. As you're [h]well[/h] aware - seeing as how you just fished it out of the back of my typewriter.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: To moje. Jak [h]dobrze[/h] wiecie - skoro dopiero co wyłowiliście to z tyłu mojej maszyny do pisania.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: That's right, I was watching. I don't [h]disappear[/h] when you stop talking to me, you know.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Zgadza się, patrzyłem. Nie [h]znikam,[/h] kiedy przestajecie do mnie mówić, wiecie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: The envelope's addressed to [h]you[/h]... but it says 'Dear [h]James[/h]' at the top of the letter.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Koperta jest zaadresowana do [h]ciebie...[/h] ale na górze listu jest napisane 'Drogi [h]Jamesie'.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: Congratulations - you've sussed out what the [i]J[/i] in my name stands for.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Gratulacje - rozgryzłaś, co oznacza [i]J[/i] w moim imieniu.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: If that's the height of your investigative prowess, we're all in trouble.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Jeśli to szczyt waszych zdolności detektywistycznych, mamy poważny problem.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: It's signed by someone named [i]T. W. Ibis...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Jest podpisany przez kogoś o imieniu [i]T. W. Ibis...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: You know, of all the detectives I've met, you two really are the most recent.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Wiecie, ze wszystkich detektywów, jakich poznałem, wy dwoje jesteście naprawdę najnowsi.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.en: Grimoire, he's being mean to us.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.pl: Grimoire, on jest dla nas złośliwy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HandwrittenLett.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.en: Uh, yes? Something you wanted to ask?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.pl: Yy, tak? Coś, o co chcieliście zapytać?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.en: We thought you might know what it is, since... [i]you know...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.pl: Pomyśleliśmy, że może wiesz, czym to jest, skoro... [i]no wiesz...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.en: I wrote a book called [i]'Hex of the Helmsman?'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.en: Yeah, no, I've got nothing. Done. Next.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.pl: Tak, nie, nic nie mam. Koniec. Następny.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexBottle/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: I - I'd [i]really[/i] rather not reduce it to a single sentence-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Ja - [i]naprawdę[/i] wolałbym nie sprowadzać tego do jednego zdania-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: It's about a guy named Markus Mordoom looking for something called [i]The Devil of the Deep.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Jest o facecie o imieniu Markus Mordoom, który szuka czegoś, co nazywa się [i]Diabeł Głębin.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: Yeah, kind of. It gets a little abstract towards the end.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Tak, niby. Pod koniec robi się trochę abstrakcyjnie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: It's also a love story. Markus is in love with a woman named Belicia. She's his Captain.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: To też jest historia miłosna. Markus jest zakochany w kobiecie imieniem Belicia. Jest jego Kapitanem.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: I just think it'd be better if you took the [i]time-[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Po prostu myślę, że byłoby lepiej, gdybyście poświęcili [i]czas-[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: So what, it's just Markus Mordoom, on his ship, and that's it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Więc co, to tylko Markus Mordoom, na swoim statku, i tyle?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: I don't see her on the cover...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: Really, all the nuance is lost if we just-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Naprawdę, cały niuans ginie, jeśli po prostu-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: No, she's there. Kinda. Like I said, it gets abstract.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Nie, jest tam. Niby. Jak mówiłam, robi się abstrakcyjnie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: I'll... take your word for it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: Hmph - if you'd like to [i]read[/i] it I have a spare copy you can-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Hmph - jeśli chcielibyście to [i]przeczytać,[/i] mam zapasowy egzemplarz, który możecie-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Nie, w porządku. Nie mam czasu.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: So - [i]you've[/i] read it, Sally, but Grimoire hasn't?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Więc - [i]ty[/i] to czytałaś, Sally, ale Grimoire nie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.en: We're talking about [i]several themes[/i] carefully laid on top of each other-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.pl: Mówimy o [i]kilku wątkach[/i] starannie nałożonych na siebie-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE HexoftheHelmsma.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: Great pull quotes - that's some [i]strong[/i] marketing for a small-town theatre...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: Świetne cytaty reklamowe - to całkiem [i]mocny[/i] marketing jak na teatr z małego miasteczka...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: Did you ever see the show?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: Yeah, I did - as part of my old newspaper job.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: Tak, widziałem - w ramach mojej dawnej pracy w gazecie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: Why's it called Lady of the Looking Glass?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: Czemu nazywa się to Dama Zwierciadła?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: The central trick was Symmetry talking to herself in a mirror. Only sometimes the reflection didn't move with her.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: Główną sztuczką było to, że Symmetry rozmawiała ze sobą w lustrze. Tyle że czasem odbicie się z nią nie poruszało.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: My guess is the mirror can switch between being [i]reflective[/i] and being see-through glass.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: Zgaduję, że lustro potrafi przełączać się między byciem [i]odbijającym[/i] a przezroczystym szkłem.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: You know - looking through to a [i]second[/i] Symmetry on the other side.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: No wiecie - patrząc na [i]drugą[/i] Symmetry po drugiej stronie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.en: Ehhh, probably just a very good dummy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.pl: Ehh, pewnie po prostu bardzo dobra atrapa.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IllusionistPost.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: The Stonetop Inn's been in the town a [i]long[/i] time...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: Gospoda Stonetop jest w miasteczku [i]od dawna...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: It was a little [i]bawdry[/i] for my tastes - but that's sailors for you.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: Była trochę zbyt [i]sprośna[/i] jak na mój gust - ale takie już są marynarze.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: My father was a [h]frequent[/h] patron, though. He, uh - he had a thing for the innkeeper...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: Mój ojciec był jednak [h]częstym[/h] bywalcem. On, yy - miał słabość do karczmarki...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: Did you ever see Mortuga in there?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: It's possible, but I don't remember it... he probably looked different back then, anyway.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: To możliwe, ale nie pamiętam tego... zresztą pewnie wyglądał wtedy inaczej.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: The deeds seem to say that [i]'Don Drummond'[/i] was the most recent owner.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: Akt zdaje się mówić, że [i]'Don Drummond'[/i] był ostatnim właścicielem.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: Well... I don't think there are any Stonetops [h]left.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: No cóż... nie sądzę, żeby [h]zostali[/h] jacyś Stonetopowie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: We were in the Inn earlier today - it's been abandoned, just like everything else.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: Byliśmy dziś wcześniej w Gospodzie - jest opuszczona, tak jak wszystko inne.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.en: It's hard to imagine the Stonetops selling the Inn, it's been their family home for generations.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.pl: Trudno wyobrazić sobie, żeby Stonetopowie sprzedali Gospodę, to ich rodzinny dom od pokoleń.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE InnDeeds/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.en: Ugh. I wanna know what this is. It's gotta be [h]something.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.pl: Ugh. Chcę wiedzieć, czym to jest. Musi być [h]czymś.[/h]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.en: Did you see the carvings around the outside? It-it's a little story in four parts.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.pl: Widzieliście te rzeźbienia dookoła? To-to mała historia w czterech częściach.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.en: There's an egg, then it hatches, then there's a baby, then it goes into the water.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.pl: Jest jajko, potem się wykluwa, potem jest dziecko, potem wchodzi do wody.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.en: I'm not sure it's a baby, either.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.pl: Nie jestem też pewna, czy to dziecko.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE IronBell/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.en: Huh. I didn't know she was still using it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.pl: Hę. Nie wiedziałem, że wciąż jej używa.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.en: Yeah - I figured she would've gotten rid of it by now.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.pl: Tak - myślałem, że już by się jej pozbyła.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.en: What did she [h]used[/h] to use it for?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.en: This... is the [i]Lady of the Looking Glass[/i] herself.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.en: It's a body double. Kinda like having a twin - but you don't have to pay it anything.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.pl: To sobowtór. Trochę jak posiadanie bliźniaczki - tylko nie trzeba jej niczego płacić.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE LifesizeDoll/Se.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.en: Have you ever seen this painting before? - Before the [i]submarine[/i], I mean.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.pl: Widziałeś ten obraz wcześniej? - Przed [i]łodzią podwodną,[/i] mam na myśli.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.en: Yeah - it used to hang in the Stonetop Inn. For a little while, at least.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.pl: Tak - kiedyś wisiał w Gospodzie Stonetop. Przynajmniej przez jakiś czas.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.en: Really? Seems like it would scare away all the customers...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.pl: Naprawdę? Wydaje się, że odstraszyłby wszystkich klientów...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.en: Nah, old sailor types [i]love[/i] stuff like this. It's a - conversation piece, isn't it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.pl: Nie, starzy marynarze [i]uwielbiają[/i] takie rzeczy. To - temat do rozmowy, prawda?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MermaidPainting.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.en: Do you know what this is?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.en:
Well, it's a [i]bottle[/i], isn't it?
Wh-where did you find it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.pl:
Cóż, to [i]butelka,[/i] prawda?
Gd-gdzie to znaleźliście?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.en: Madam Tadpole's room. She like to collect stuff she finds in the ocean.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.pl: Pokój Madam Tadpole. Lubi zbierać rzeczy, które znajduje w oceanie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.en:
Mm, [i]does she now![/i]
What fun, what fun...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.pl:
Mm, [i]doprawdy!?[/i]
Cóż za zabawa, cóż za zabawa...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.en:
Mr Wirman?
Do you know what this bottle is?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.pl:
Panie Wirman?
Wiesz, czym jest ta butelka?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MessageinaBottl.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.en: This is supposed to be [i]Silkwirm[/i], is it?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.en: I don't think it's [h]trying[/h] to be accurate - it's more about Mortuga's specific-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.pl: Nie sądzę, żeby [h]próbował[/h] być dokładny - chodzi bardziej o konkretną-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.en: Huh. I'll make a note of it.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.en: Uh - what was your father's name?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.pl: Yy - jak miał na imię twój ojciec?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.en: He's got the right look, and he's standing outside the building that [h]would[/h] be the town hall, if it wasn't just a wooden cube...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.pl: Wygląda odpowiednio, i stoi przed budynkiem, który [h]byłby[/h] ratuszem, gdyby nie był po prostu drewnianą kostką...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ModelTown/Secti.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.en: Wow. Never would've thought of that.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.pl: Wow. Nigdy bym o tym nie pomyślała.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.en: Uh - who? I don't think we've met him yet.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.pl: Yy - kogo? Chyba jeszcze go nie poznaliśmy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.en: Ehh - it's a [i]logic principle.[/i] Basically, the... simplest explanation is most likely to be correct.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.pl: Ehh - to [i]zasada logiczna.[/i] Zasadniczo... najprostsze wyjaśnienie jest najbardziej prawdopodobne.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.en:
If that were [i]always[/i] true...
I think I'd be out of a job.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.pl:
Gdyby to było [i]zawsze[/i] prawdą...
Myślę, że straciłbym pracę.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MoonVial/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: So, these are the two main characters in the movie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Więc to są dwie główne postaci w filmie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: The helmsman Markus Mordoom and his captain, Belicia Bonetop.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Sternik Markus Mordoom i jego kapitan, Belicia Bonetop.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: You're not happy with how they look? Compared to your book?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Nie jesteś zadowolony z tego, jak wyglądają? W porównaniu do twojej książki?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: Ehh, they made Markus too handsome - and too bulky.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Ehh, zrobili Markusa zbyt przystojnym - i zbyt masywnym.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: Sure, he'd have muscle, but at the same time he's supposed to be wiry - [i]fibrous[/i] - like an old piece of rope.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Jasne, miałby mięśnie, ale jednocześnie ma być żylasty - [i]włóknisty[/i] - jak stary kawałek liny.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: Meanwhile, Belicia's supposed to be more [i]ethereal[/i] - like she might evaporate if you tried to reach out and touch her.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Tymczasem Belicia ma być bardziej [i]eteryczna[/i] - jakby mogła wyparować, gdybyś spróbował ją dotknąć.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: [i]If your story hinges on a specific necklace, then make it the only necklace in the story[/i] - this is [h]basic[/h] stuff, people!!
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: [i]Jeśli twoja historia opiera się na konkretnym naszyjniku, to zrób go jedynym naszyjnikiem w historii[/i] - to [h]podstawy,[/h] ludzie!!
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: - and - [h]and[/h] - for some reason they gave them [i]both[/i] necklaces, when it's [i]Belicia's[/i] necklace that the story hinges on.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: - i - [h]i[/h] - z jakiegoś powodu dali naszyjniki [i]obojgu,[/i] kiedy to naszyjnik [i]Belicii[/i] jest tym, na którym opiera się historia.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.en: Oh. well. You can't have everything-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.pl: Och. cóż. Nie można mieć wszystkiego-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE MovieMagazine/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.en: I cut my teeth writing local interest stories like this.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.pl: Zdobywałem szlify, pisząc takie lokalne historie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.en: [h]You[/h] wrote this? The review of Sym's old magic show?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.pl: [h]Ty[/h] to napisałeś? Recenzję dawnego pokazu magii Sym?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.en: But it says [i]'Theatre Review by James Dusk.'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.pl: Ale jest napisane [i]'Recenzja teatralna, James Dusk'.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.en: -aand she finally works out what the [i]J. D.[/i] stands for in [i]J. D. Wirman.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.pl: -i wreszcie rozgryzła, co oznacza [i]J. D.[/i] w [i]J. D. Wirman.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.en: [h]Sorry[/h] - your name is [i]James Dusk[/i] and you - [i]changed[/i] it??
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.pl: [h]Przepraszam[/h] - masz na imię [i]James Dusk[/i] i - [i]zmieniłeś[/i] je??
Conversation/Wirman CLUE NewspaperPage/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE RaggedCloth/Sec.en: Sounds like a good [i]title[/i] for something.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE RaggedCloth/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE RaggedCloth/Sec.en: Like a book? Or a film?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE RaggedCloth/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.en: Uh, so - I was really banking on Mortuga having some kind of [i]exciting secret mission...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.pl: Yy, więc - naprawdę liczyłem na to, że Mortuga ma jakąś [i]ekscytującą tajną misję...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.en: Something that justified the whole [i]submarine[/i] thing - you know?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.pl: Coś, co uzasadniałoby całą tę sprawę z [i]łodzią podwodną[/i] - no wiecie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.en: A treasure map? I was [h]looking[/h] for something like this...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.en: No - in fact he was weirdly [i]aimless...[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.en: ...like he didn't even want to [i]be[/i] here.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SeaChart/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.en: -is it based on a real ship?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.en: I'd assume so, Mortuga did work as a sailor of sorts, back before the submarine.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.pl: Zakładałbym, że tak, Mortuga pracował jako swego rodzaju marynarz, jeszcze przed łodzią podwodną.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.en: It looks like the little Mortuga's standing by the wheel. So that'd make him the helmsman?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.pl: Wygląda na to, że mały Mortuga stoi przy kole. Więc byłby sternikiem?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.en: Oh no, it was a Stonetop ship he worked on. The same people that owned the Inn.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.pl: Och nie, to był statek Stonetopów, na którym pracował. Ci sami ludzie, którzy byli właścicielami Gospody.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipinaBottle/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.en: Hm. I noticed the wheel is thematically consistent with the submarine at large.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.pl: Hm. Zauważyłem, że koło jest tematycznie spójne z całą łodzią podwodną.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.en: Well it's, uh - cobbled together from other component parts.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.pl: Cóż, jest, yy - sklecone z innych części składowych.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.en: You know, parts that were, by themselves, broken or otherwise disused.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.pl: No wiecie, części, które same w sobie były zepsute albo nieużywane.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE ShipsWheel/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: The symbol on the top left, next to [i]Governor's Manor,[/i] that's the Fellow emblem.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.pl: Symbol w lewym górnym rogu, obok [i]Rezydencji Gubernatora,[/i] to godło Fellowów.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: Hmmm, oh - that's my father's emblem, on the top right - the one next to [i]Town Hall.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.pl: Hmmm, och - to godło mojego ojca, w prawym górnym rogu - to obok [i]Ratusza.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: Your dad was the mayor and you grew up in the Town Hall? Must've been nice.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.pl: Twój tata był burmistrzem i dorastałeś w Ratuszu? Musiało być miło.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: Your dad is listed on the back here, on the family tree...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.pl: Twój tata jest wypisany tutaj z tyłu, na drzewie genealogicznym...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: -and there's a line between him and Felicia Stonetop, see?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.pl: -i jest linia między nim a Felicią Stonetop, widzisz?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: Hmph - it's a [i]stretch[/i] to call this a family tree.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.pl: Hmph - to [i]naciągane,[/i] żeby nazywać to drzewem genealogicznym.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.en: More like a tree of [i]speculative conjecture.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sec.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.en: That belongs to Dirk, I think.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.pl: To należy do Dirka, jak sądzę.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.en: We found it in the bilge, floating in the water.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.pl: Znaleźliśmy to w zęzie, unoszące się na wodzie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.en: I assumed it was a movie prop. You know - a sci-fi thing?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.pl: Założyłem, że to rekwizyt filmowy. No wiecie - coś w stylu sci-fi?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.en: Has Dirk ever [i]done[/i] a movie like that?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.pl: Czy Dirk kiedykolwiek [i]zagrał[/i] w takim filmie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.pl: Nic mi o tym nie wiadomo.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.en: No idea! You'd better ask him, hadn't you?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.pl: Nie mam pojęcia! Lepiej go zapytajcie, prawda?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE StrangeDevice/S.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.en: The blue part's from an original blueprint of a submarine...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.pl: Niebieska część pochodzi z oryginalnego planu łodzi podwodnej...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.en: ...and the yellow-ish parts are from a technical drawing of a ship - still a blueprint of sorts, but a bit older.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.pl: ...a żółtawe części pochodzą z technicznego rysunku statku - wciąż swego rodzaju plan, ale trochę starszy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.en: We used to keep records like this in the town hall...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.pl: Trzymaliśmy kiedyś takie dokumenty w ratuszu...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.en: Where did Sinthia get them from?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.en: I don't know. Maybe she took them from Mortuga's desk.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.pl: Nie wiem. Może wzięła je z biurka Mortugi.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SubmarineBluepr.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.en: Ugh. How I wish I'd remembered to bring painkillers...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.pl: Ugh. Jakże żałuję, że nie pamiętałem, żeby zabrać środki przeciwbólowe...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.pl: Czy którekolwiek z [i]tych[/i] to środki przeciwbólowe?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.en: -and nice harmless organic ones, too - they wouldn't even take the edge off a headache.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.pl: -i to miłe, nieszkodliwe, organiczne - nawet by nie złagodziły bólu głowy.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE SunTablets/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: How come the keys are all messed up on your typewriter?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: Czemu wszystkie klawisze w twojej maszynie do pisania są pomieszane?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: It's old! Sometimes they fall off. I guess I don't always put them back in the right place.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: Jest stara! Czasem odpadają. Chyba nie zawsze wkładam je z powrotem we właściwe miejsce.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: And uh... what've you typed on that page?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: A yy... co napisałeś na tej stronie?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: I'm... taking another swing at a story outline. For my next book.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: Ja... próbuję jeszcze raz ze szkicem fabuły. Do mojej następnej książki.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: I can't make it out, it's some kind of weird grid...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: Nie umiem tego rozczytać, to jakaś dziwna siatka...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: [i]Cross-writing.[/i] Look it up, people used to do it all the time.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: [i]Pismo krzyżowe.[/i] Poszukajcie, ludzie kiedyś robili to cały czas.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: What about these brass panels on the back?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: A co z tymi mosiężnymi panelami z tyłu?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: This one's my Father's emblem. Mayor [i]Dusk[/i] - that's why it looks like a 'D'.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: Ten to godło mojego Ojca. Burmistrz [i]Dusk[/i] - dlatego wygląda jak 'D'.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.en: -and this is the Governor's emblem. Governor [i]Fellow[/i] - so that one's an 'F'.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.pl: -a to jest godło Gubernatora. Gubernator [i]Fellow[/i] - więc to jest 'F'.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE Typewriter/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE UnderwaterPhoto.en: [i]Look[/i] buddy, I got enough going on, alright?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE UnderwaterPhoto.pl: [i]Słuchaj[/i] koleżko, mam wystarczająco dużo na głowie, dobra?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE UnderwaterPhoto.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE UnderwaterPhoto.en: I don't think I have the capacity to worry about this.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE UnderwaterPhoto.pl: Nie sądzę, żebym miał teraz siły martwić się tym.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE UnderwaterPhoto.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.en: I [i]tried[/i] asking Mortuga what this was...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.en: He just said it was something he'd [i]'picked up on his travels.'[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.pl: Powiedział tylko, że to coś, co [i]'znalazł podczas swoich podróży'.[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.en: Picked up [h]where?[/h] Floating somewhere in the middle of the ocean?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.pl: Znalazł [h]gdzie?[/h] Unoszące się gdzieś na środku oceanu?
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.en: [h]You[/h] look like someone who might smoke...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.pl: [h]Ty[/h] wyglądasz na kogoś, kto mógłby palić...
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.en: Hey, no, he's right. Look at me.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.pl: Hej, nie, on ma rację. Spójrzcie na mnie.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.en:
[i]Mariana Moon[/i] on the other hand doesn't [i]touch[/i] the stuff, seeing as how her only pipe... is actually a [i]dictaphone.
[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.pl:
[i]Mariana Moon[/i] za to nawet nie [i]tyka[/i] tego świństwa, zważywszy że jej jedyna fajka... to tak naprawdę [i]dyktafon.
[/i]
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.en: Oh, you can literally hear the tape [i]spinning[/i] when she's recording-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.pl: Och, dosłownie słychać, jak taśma się [i]kręci,[/i] kiedy nagrywa-
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.en: It's not as subtle as she likes to think.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.pl: To nie jest tak subtelne, jak jej się wydaje.
Conversation/Wirman CLUE WoodenPipe/Sect.speaker: Wirman
